title: Best Time to Visit Maharashtra: Weather, Festivals & Tips
summary: Planning your trip? Here is the detailed weather calendar, seasonal breakdown, and festival guide for Maharashtra.
content: To truly experience the soul of Maharashtra, timing is everything. Whether you want to witness the grand Ganesh Chaturthi in September, ski on snowy peaks, or relax on golden sands, this monthly seasonal guide tells you when to book your tickets. We recommend visiting between October and March for cool, pleasant days, or exploring the lush green landscapes right after the monsoons.
